description.intro:
Hello, I am Sheng-Yun Yu (Brian Yu), a software engineer with around 8 years of experience, working mainly on the backend with Node.js / TypeScript and NestJS. I designed the microservice architecture for a gaming and live-streaming platform, handling high-concurrency betting and order traffic, cross-service event streams, and asynchronous settlement, along with MySQL performance tuning and Redis caching design. I have also led 11 engineers through several product releases.

On the frontend I work with React / Next.js, so I can take a feature from the database and API through to the interface without waiting on another role.

Over the past six months I have brought AI into both the product and the development process, working with Claude / Claude Code and building my own RAG and evaluation framework in Python + FastAPI, with retrieval quality metrics running in CI. In my current work, AI already powers match suggestions, chat coaching, icebreakers, and bio generation, and I have covered the full path from feature design and backend integration through to release.

I am looking for a Senior Backend Engineer role, or one that combines backend engineering with AI.
